name: The Horned King

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Block on the facing page (PDF 565). The block has no Secret (the story hides Phillip Druskenvald inside). Spell save DC 20 is the book's; +12 to hit with spells is computed (Charisma +6, proficiency +6).

traits.name: Enduring Restoration
traits.summary: Killed, its body falls to ash and it lives on as an intangible, Invisible spirit in its forest, unable to take a new body for 10d10 years.
traits.text: If the Horned King dies, its body disappears in a cloud of ash. It becomes an intangible, Invisible spirit in its home forest and cannot form a new physical body for 10d10 years.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.summary: Five times a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Horned King fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 5 times a day.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regional Effects (Lair)
traits.summary: Within a mile of its lair: acting on a sinful impulse against a friendly or indifferent creature grants +10 max and current HP until a long rest (once per long rest, known to all), and saving throws against curses have Disadvantage.
traits.text: Regional effects, within 1 mile of the clearing and its twisted tree while the Horned King lives and keeps its lair there. Sweet Temptation: a creature that acts on a sinful impulse to the harm of a Friendly or Indifferent creature raises its Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points by 10 until it finishes a Long Rest; creatures know this, and it can't happen again until after the next Long Rest. Tenacious Curses: saving throws against curses have Disadvantage. Both end the moment it dies or moves its lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three Cursed Strikes; one can be replaced by Terrorizing Breath.

actions.name: Cursed Strike
actions.summary: +12 (a 19 or 20 is a Critical Hit against a cursed target), reach 10 ft, 2d10+6 Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing (his pick) plus 2d6 Necrotic; the target is cursed until the end of his next turn (-1d4 on D20 Tests).
actions.text: A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) damage of his choice of Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic. A creature it hits is cursed until the end of his next turn and subtracts 1d4 from its D20 Tests. Against a cursed target his attack roll scores a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

actions.name: Breath of Corruption
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. 60-ft cone, DC 19 Dex save: 6d6 Necrotic plus 6d6 Psychic and 1 Exhaustion level that ends at the end of the target's next turn; half damage on a success.

actions.name: Terrorizing Breath
actions.summary: 60-ft cone, DC 19 Wis save or Frightened (save again each turn; a minute at most).

actions.name: Taste of Wickedness

params.of: the Horned King's curses on the target

actions.summary: Legendary only. One cursed creature he sees within 15 ft: DC 20 Cha save or 3d10 Psychic; he heals the same and ends one of his curses on it.

bonus_actions.name: Sense Desire
bonus_actions.summary: Casts Detect Thoughts (Charisma, DC 20, no components).

options.name: Taste of Wickedness
options.summary: A cursed creature within 15 ft: DC 20 Cha save or 3d10 Psychic; he heals that much and lifts one of his curses from it.

options.name: Temptation
options.summary: Offers a creature within 120 ft Heroic Inspiration or 20 Hit Points; if it accepts, it gets it but is cursed for 1 minute and he resists all damage that creature deals. Once a round.
options.text: He speaks to a creature he can see within 120 feet and offers it either Heroic Inspiration or 20 restored Hit Points. If it accepts it gains the benefit but is cursed for a minute; while it is cursed the Horned King has Resistance to all damage that creature deals. He can't tempt again until his next turn starts.

options.name: Trample
options.summary: Moves up to half his Speed and makes one Cursed Strike. Once a round.

summary: Sin made flesh as a winged, horned giant: three cursing strikes, a corrupting breath and a cone of terror, a tongue that feeds on curses, and an offer of reward that binds whoever takes it.
